class.name: GPUErosion
class.brief_description: GPU-accelerated particle-based hydraulic erosion via Vulkan compute shaders.
class.description: Uses RenderingDevice to dispatch erosion particles on the GPU in parallel. Heightmap data is stored as fixed-point integers in storage buffers, and atomicAdd is used for thread-safe concurrent writes. Supports grids from 128×128 up to 4096×4096 with 100K+ particles in milliseconds.

method.name: erode
method.description: Runs GPU erosion. Returns Dictionary with "height", "sediment", and "completed" keys.

method.name: is_gpu_available
method.description: Returns true if the Vulkan compute pipeline initialised successfully.
